title: Capture stands resolve exact pinned fleet image identities before startup
steps: Run the pure image-policy tests and isolated stand startup/version fixtures without Docker, model calls or release downloads.
expect: The stand preserves Joomla6 and WordPressPHP8.3 bases and follows their exact canonical fleet policy rows.
Missing, duplicate, malformed, upstream, floating and wrong-base declarations fail without fallback.
Invalid policy refuses startup before a download or container command, and unknown release versions still refuse.

tests: stand images follow the authoritative fleet policy and preserve exact CMS bases
stand image policy refuses missing, ambiguous, malformed and mismatched base declarations
an invalid stand image policy refuses startup before any release download or container command
